title: Higher Education Support Amendment (Fix HECS) Bill 2026
short_title: Higher Education Support Amendment (Fix HECS) Bill 2026

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would change when student loan debts are adjusted for inflation each year.
It would move the annual indexation date from 1 June to 1 November, so that repayments made during the financial year are deducted from the debt before the adjustment.
The indexation factors would use more recent economic data, and a transitional rule-making power would handle the one-off shift in 2026.
changes: Moves the annual HELP debt indexation date from 1 June to 1 November.
Updates the CPI and WPI indexation factors to use quarterly data ending 30 June instead of 31 December.
Includes a transitional rule-making power for the implementation year.
summary.affected: People with HELP debts who make compulsory or voluntary repayments.
